mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months signals an easing monetary policy cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A labor market contraction signaled by unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 3.5% indicates strong job creation and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5, or the signal fails to outperform the market in 3-year rolling windows (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS above 2.0% and UNRATE below 4.0% signals a monetary tightening cycle with strong labor market, increasing recession risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, housing starts (HOUST) above 1,200 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) below 500,000 million dollars indicate potential consumer spending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal fails to have a positive Rank IC in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months signals robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strong INDPRO periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI growth exceeding 2.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that increases discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL (YoY) > 2.5%, or the signal fails to outperform the market in 3-year rolling windows (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion regime, GDP growth (GDPC1) above 20,000 billion dollars signals robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when the regime is early-cycle expansion, or the signal fails to have a positive Rank IC in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Labor market strength signaled by employment levels (PAYEMS) exceeding 150,000 thousand persons indicates strong consumer spending power, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000, or the signal fails to outperform the market in 3-year rolling windows (t-test p > 0.05).
